Selected excerpt: Three.js Game Development, Core Workflow
1. Identify genre, target browsers/devices, input methods, camera style, assets, physics needs and publishing target.
2. Structure the loop around input sampling, fixed or semi-fixed simulation, animation, world update, camera update, rendering and cleanup.
3. Keep scene concerns separate from gameplay state; avoid hiding game rules in mesh traversal or material callbacks.
4. Name/reference important objects, group transforms, avoid per-frame searches, and dispose owned rendering resources when no longer used.
5. Load assets through explicit loading states and predictable relative paths.
6. Verify nonblank framing, interaction and performance across target viewports.
